name: Reboundly
summary: A physio clinic app with a drag-and-drop schedule, patient flow and recovery charts
about: A clinic management app for a physiotherapy or rehab practice, shown with sample data from a five-clinician clinic. Sessions drag between clinicians and times, a flow board tracks patients from check-in to exercises, and a recovery view bends a drawn joint to each session's range of motion while the charts follow.
how: Open Overview and drag patients from Booked to Done on the flow board, or use the arrow for a Move to… menu
Open Schedule: drag a session to another clinician or time, switch to Week for one clinician, or press Enter for options
Open Recovery, pick a patient and drag the session slider: the knee, arm or back bends and the chart markers move
Log a session with range, pain and strength; milestones tick and goals raise a notification
Build a home program by dragging exercises into the plan, reorder them, edit sets and send it
Check each clinician's week, sell session packs and mark bills paid with 7D, 30D and 12M charts
Switch the light or dark theme and reset the demo data in Settings
